figurative_meaning_en: Without excess; somehow or by any means
similar_in_english: By the skin of one's teeth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মাথায় মাথায় কাজটা শেষ করল।
আমরা মাথায় মাথায় এই যাত্রা সম্পন্ন করেছি।
example_sentences_in_english: He completed the work just barely, head to head.
We managed the journey somehow, by the narrowest margin.
note: This idiom reflects resourcefulness in Bengali folk expressions.
